retryable: transient filesystem access before final publication
process interruption after a sealed snapshot exists
transient verifier/open failure when candidate identity and sealed snapshot remain exact
nonretryable: process interruption while report_attempt is still staging because the stable read Snapshot cannot be resumed safely
retry_policy.rule: retry never reuses mutable live-domain reads after sealing and never fabricates a new report_attempt_id

crash_recovery_policy.reconcile_first: reload the owning sla_report_attempt plus this checkpoint and any pending command receipt before choosing work; job/checkpoint state never overrides the domain attempt state
crash_recovery_policy.staging: an interrupted stable-read generation is not resumable from an arbitrary in-memory position; if a pending StageReportSnapshotBatch receipt committed, reconcile that exact committed batch first, then fail the still-unsealed attempt through FailSlaReportAttempt and require a new explicit report attempt rather than mixing a new read Snapshot into old staging
crash_recovery_policy.ready_to_generate_or_generating: regenerate deterministically from the exact sealed report_attempt_id + snapshot_hash; no live SR/CPL/policy/contributor query is permitted
crash_recovery_policy.verifying: reverify only the exact persisted safe candidate identity when it still resolves inside the validated destination context; otherwise discard only that attempt-owned temporary candidate and regenerate from the sealed snapshot
crash_recovery_policy.published_before_completion: when checkpoint contains an exact verified-and-published completion proof but CompleteSlaReport has not committed, retry only CompleteSlaReport with the same durable command_id and proof; do not rewrite or republish the artifact
crash_recovery_policy.terminal: completed, failed and cancelled report attempts are never restarted into mutable report work

cancellation_policy.authoritative_request: The public CancelSlaReportAttempt command does not wait on or trust an in-memory worker signal. In one LLD-06 UnitOfWork it resolves replay, revalidates the nonterminal report attempt and exact sla_report_job_refs identity, inserts the LLD-06 receipt, calls LLD-01 DurableJobCoordinator.cancel as a receipt-free same-UoW participant, removes only non-authoritative report staging, and commits cancelled report/job state together.
cancellation_policy.completion_race: CancelSlaReportAttempt and CompleteSlaReport serialize through authoritative SQLite writes. Completion-first makes the report immutable and cancellation rolls back without changing the durable job. Cancellation-first revokes the job claim and makes the report cancelled, so later worker checkpoints/transitions/CompleteSlaReport fail their exact claim/domain-state revalidation.
cancellation_policy.inflight_external_work: A revoked worker may physically finish external CPU/XLSX/atomic-rename work that had already started before the cancellation commit. Such completion grants no coordinator/domain authority. A final file that appears after cancellation is external non-authoritative housekeeping and is never automatically deleted as if it were a temporary candidate.
cancellation_policy.temporary_cleanup: After a successful cancellation commit, best-effort cleanup may target only the persisted bounded sibling temporary candidate captured from verifying state through the validated destination context; cleanup failure cannot change cancelled authority.
cancellation_policy.shutdown_signal: Foundation host shutdown cooperative signalling remains a separate technical stop mechanism; correctness of operator report cancellation depends only on persisted claim/domain-state validation.

jobs.sensitive_field_policy: payload/checkpoint contain only report/job ids, opaque destination token, hashes, safe filename identities, bounded counters/revisions and command ids; no filesystem path, credentials, report row bodies, Communication bodies, Working Notes, unrestricted contributor payloads or mutable live-domain records
jobs.coalescing: none across distinct explicit report requests; COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 replay of StartSlaReportGeneration reuses the same report_attempt/job identity, but separate accepted starts remain separate jobs

fields.report_attempt_id: uuid of the single LLD-06 report attempt owned by this job
fields.destination_request_token: sha256 token bound to the previously validated destination request; never a raw path
fields.requested_by_command_id: uuid of the accepted StartSlaReportGeneration command receipt

fields.attempt_revision: int>=1 copied only as technical retry/concurrency context and always revalidated against sla_report_attempts
fields.snapshot_generation_token: opaque <=256-byte token|null; non-null only for the exact current stable-read staging generation
fields.next_batch_ordinal: int>=1|null; next bounded staging batch ordinal for the current generation
fields.candidate_filename: bounded safe sibling temporary filename|null; no directory/absolute/traversal component

fields.command_id: uuid durably assigned before the owning LLD-06 command is first invoked and reused on every retry
fields.request_fingerprint: sha256 over the exact bounded command intent needed to reconcile a crash
fields.snapshot_hash: sha256|null; exact sealed/recomputed snapshot identity when required by the operation
fields.candidate_filename: bounded safe sibling temporary filename|null; present only when the operation binds a candidate
fields.completion_proof_fingerprint: sha256|null; present only for complete and bound to SlaReportPublishedArtifactCheckpointV1

rules: stage_batch requires batch_ordinal and batch_payload_sha256; normalized report row bodies are never copied into the durable job checkpoint
seal/mark_generating/mark_verifying/complete bind snapshot_hash when their command contract requires it; mark_verifying also binds candidate_filename
complete requires completion_proof_fingerprint matching the exact published_artifact checkpoint and reuses published_artifact.completion_command_id as command_id
for a crash with an uncommitted stage_batch pending command, the old stable-read generation is abandoned rather than reconstructed from current live state
for sealed/artifact transitions every retried command payload is reconstructed only from immutable/sealed attempt state plus exact safe checkpoint metadata

operator cancellation is driven by the public CancelSlaReportAttempt COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 identity; a worker-local pending kind=cancel may exist only to reconcile a response-loss retry of that same committed cancellation, never as a second cancellation authority

fields.candidate_filename: bounded safe sibling temporary filename that was verified
fields.artifact_sha256: sha256 hex of the exact published bytes
fields.snapshot_hash: sha256 hex of the exact sealed REPORT_SNAPSHOT_V1
fields.completion_command_id: uuid assigned before first CompleteSlaReport invocation and reused until exact completion/replay

SlaReportPublishedArtifactCheckpointV1.rule: this checkpoint is technical recovery proof only; CompletedReportEvidence exists only after CompleteSlaReport commits

rules: Exactly one SLA_REPORT_GENERATION_V1 job is linked to one sla_report_attempts row through sla_report_job_refs; the job never becomes report lifecycle authority.
All filesystem enumeration/write/hash/verify/publish work and stable-read report construction occur outside SQLite writer transactions; domain mutations use the named LLD-06 commands only.
Checkpoint writes are bounded and contain no report snapshot row bodies; authoritative snapshot content remains only in LLD-06 staging tables and becomes immutable evidence only at CompleteSlaReport.
A worker assigns and checkpoints each internal command_id before first invocation. Exact committed replay is reconciled before minting any replacement command identity.

Before every coordinator checkpoint/complete/fail call and before every owning-domain report transition after external work, the handler must use current claim/domain state; a claim revoked by operator cancellation cannot be treated as still running.
Foundation restore reconciliation cancels restored nonterminal jobs; no Beta 1.0 restore path silently resumes historical report generation.
